draft.shortGloss: to tell; to inform; to indicate
draft.emotion: straightforward and helpful, sharing information clearly with someone
notes: Use บอก (bɔ̀ɔk) when conveying information to someone. For the physical act of speaking or speaking a language, use พูด (phûut).
Very commonly followed by ว่า (wâa, 'that') to introduce what was said: บอกว่า... ('said/told that...').
